Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Lottie Traditional Wool Area Rug, 8 x 10 Foot, Beige
Materials: wool
80% Wool 20% Cotton Imported Eye-catching design in a classic pattern and neutral beige color will set a graceful tone to a dining area, entryway or bedroom. Soft wool exudes charm and warmth like no other fiber. Freshen up your home with this beautiful rug. 8' x 10' Hand-tufted in India Medium pile height makes it durable and easy to vacuum Vacuum, professionally clean Pair with a rug pad, which is sold separately Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag
